baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural dwelling at word 2, authorization at word 3, passive raising at word 6, repeated interior deixis, vocal remembrance, and the two daily endpoints.
baseline_models.mechanism: Authorization gives the space legitimacy, raising gives it an upward material vector, repeated interior location makes it a container, and voiced remembrance plus morning/evening recurrence makes that container a continuously maintained liturgical environment.

activation_trace.role: A dwelling or shelter supplies the bounded interior that receives and protects the repeated acts.
Licensing makes the elevation an authorized operation rather than spontaneous human monument-making.
Physical lifting or building gives the houses their material upward vector.
Vocal mention puts the divine name into audible circulation inside the space.
Ritual praise and prayer specify the recurrent activity that maintains the interior.
Early-day time and departure fix the opening edge of the daily cycle.
Late-day time closes the cycle and makes the maintenance recurrent rather than occasional.

changed_reading.after: Authorized, materially sustained interiors are kept elevated as liturgical environments by audible remembrance across the full daily cycle.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The dwelling can denote its people, while raising, mention, name, and praise all admit honor or reputation branches.
baseline_models.mechanism: The house expands metonymically into a household; elevation then acts on standing, mention carries reputation, and repeated divine praise reforms the household's public identity around divine renown rather than its own status.

activation_trace.role: The house as its people shifts the object of elevation from masonry to a resident household.
Elevation of rank supplies the household's social and ethical rise.
Honorable mention makes reputation the medium through which elevation becomes public.
Good renown locates the household's prestige in the divine name voiced there.
Exonerating praise clears false attribution and gives the household's honor a purifying orientation.

changed_reading.after: Households are ethically elevated when their recurring speech makes divine renown, rather than lineage or self-display, their public identity.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Authorization, raising, mention, name, and glorification form a chain of announcement, amplification, designation, and voiced response.
baseline_models.mechanism: The authorization root opens an announcement branch, raising opens broadcast and raised-voice branches, and mention supplies articulation; together the houses behave as licensed acoustic relays rather than silent containers.

activation_trace.role: Public notification or a call initiates the acoustic chain and gives the house a signaling function.
Disseminating a report converts physical elevation into the spread of heard content.
A raised voice supplies the audible force by which the content leaves private interiority.
Articulation on the tongue carries the named content through the relay.
Naming provides the determinate sign that the acoustic relay transmits.
Voiced praise supplies the relay's recurring message and ritual purpose.

changed_reading.before: The divine name is privately uttered inside sacred space.
changed_reading.after: The houses are authorized public sound-nodes that lift, articulate, and relay the divine name through recurring praise.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The praise root can describe coursing movement or wide movement for livelihood, morning includes going out, evening closes the span, and the house root includes nocturnal activity.
baseline_models.mechanism: The house is a hinge between night preparation, morning departure, daytime circulation, and evening return; praise is carried through that movement rather than confined to a stationary rite.

activation_trace.role: Nocturnal activity and planning make the house a station where the next cycle is prepared.
Coursing or swimming turns glorification into sustained movement through a medium.
Wide movement for livelihood places praise within ordinary circulation and work.
Morning departure launches the outward phase of the cycle.
The evening endpoint bends the movement back toward its domestic station.

changed_reading.before: Praise occurs at two fixed times in one place.
changed_reading.after: The house is a daily hinge from which praise-bearing movement departs, circulates through livelihood, and returns by evening.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated sequence of entering, recognizing human presence, making peace, and waiting for permission turns the raised house into a consent-governed interior. Divine authorization in the focus now ratifies an ethics of thresholds: sacred elevation depends on protected access, not on unrestricted visibility or entry.

activation_trace.role: The focus dwelling supplies the bounded interior whose elevation must now be read through threshold rules.
Divine licensing anchors the focus and becomes comparable to the surah's repeated human permissions.
Literal passage into an interior supplies the action that the threshold ethic regulates.
Other people's dwellings extend the focus house into ordinary domestic space where boundaries matter.
Familiarity that removes estrangement makes entry relational rather than merely spatial.
Peace-making turns the greeting into a condition of nonviolent, acknowledged access.
Withheld or granted permission makes consent an operative gate rather than decorative courtesy.

structural_cues: 24:27 orders entry, recognition, and salutation as a sequence; 24:28 blocks entry until permission and requires retreat when refused.
24:58-59 repeat permission inside the household at exposed times, while 24:62 extends permission to departure from a communal gathering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurring houses, entries, greetings, and permissions; I infer that this repeated access grammar sharpens the same two focus roots. A live alternative is that the focus refers only to specially dedicated worship buildings while the domestic rules remain parallel rather than constitutive.

changed_reading.before: God authorizes the construction or honoring of sacred buildings.
changed_reading.after: God elevates houses whose interiors are made sacred by consent-sensitive entry, acknowledged presence, and peace at the threshold.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding nested lamp assembly scales outward: niche contains lamp, lamp sits in glass, and the next interior is the house. Raising the house gives the light-bearing assembly reach, while voiced remembrance becomes the human operation by which illumination is sustained and transmitted.

activation_trace.role: The dwelling becomes the next enclosing scale around the preceding nested light apparatus.
Material elevation gives the enclosing structure visibility and reach.
Audible mention converts illumination from a static object into a humanly transmitted event.
Illumination supplies the medium that the house receives, sustains, and makes available.
A recessed lamp opening establishes the first architectural container in the nested sequence.
The lamp supplies the concentrated source whose containing logic is scaled up in the focus.
Transparent glass models containment that protects while still transmitting outward.
Ignition supplies the causal operation analogized to recurring voiced praise.

structural_cues: 24:35 ends with a nested sequence of interior locations and repeated light; 24:36 immediately resumes with another plural interior and repeats its locative marker.
The passive forms for ignition and raising allow the material analogy without naming a human initiator.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, nested containers, ignition, transmission, and a following house interior; I supply the scale-up from niche to house and the arrow from praise to sustained illumination. The alternative is a simple shift from parable to literal worship location with no architectural analogy.

changed_reading.before: Houses merely provide the location where praise follows the light parable.
changed_reading.after: Each raised house is a large-scale luminous apparatus: it protects divine light while recurring remembrance converts that light into audible, transmissible human practice.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier speech moves as a damaging material flow: an accusation is thrown, falsehood reverses truth, tongues relay it, and scandal spreads until exoneration separates the innocent from the claim. Against that chain, raising and mentioning the divine name establish a counter-channel in which authorized, accountable speech rather than reputational violence fills the house.

activation_trace.role: Broadcasting a report makes elevation a question of which speech is amplified.
Articulation on the tongue anchors the counterflow in the focus act of mention.
Verbal casting gives accusation projectile-like force and begins the harmful circulation.
Falsehood diverted from truth identifies the corrupted content carried by that circulation.
The speaking organ turns reception into person-to-person retransmission.
Diffusion and dispersal expose the network effect of repeated unaccountable utterance.
Separation from the charge supplies the repair that truthful speech must accomplish.

structural_cues: 24:11-16 traces false content from arrival through hearing, tongues, mouths, and unsupported speech.
24:19 names its social spread, and 24:23-26 move from accusation through bodily witness to exoneration.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a complete harmful-speech propagation chain and a focus centered on authorized mention; I infer that the latter functions as a counter-practice that disciplines what a house amplifies. The alternative is that divine mention and slander regulation are adjacent ethical themes without a shared acoustic mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Mentioning the divine name is a generic devotional utterance.
changed_reading.after: The raised house is a counter-infrastructure for speech: it replaces thrown, relayed scandal with authorized mention that protects and repairs public standing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following ayah keeps trade and sale active but prevents them from capturing attention; remembrance becomes established prayer and purifying transfer, and finite exchange is answered by provision beyond calculation. Morning and evening therefore frame a disciplined economic day in which value circulates without displacing praise.

activation_trace.role: Movement through livelihood lets praise inhabit economic circulation rather than require its abolition.
Morning departure opens the workday whose priorities the following sequence regulates.
The evening endpoint closes the economic day under the same remembered orientation.
Distraction names the mechanism by which a secondary activity could displace remembrance.
Profit-seeking supplies the broader economic circulation that remains present but bounded.
Price exchange supplies the concrete transaction subordinated to worship.
Rising with resolve turns prayer into an established priority rather than a residual pause.
Purification redirects accumulated value outward through the obligatory transfer.
Allotted provision answers calculable exchange with a source of value not exhausted by market accounting.

structural_cues: 24:37 is syntactically continuous with the focus and immediately names the occupants' trade, remembrance, prayer, and almsgiving.
24:38 moves from their action and increase to provision without calculation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an unbroken focus-to-occupant sequence and contrasts attention, exchange, worship, transfer, and uncounted provision; I infer a reordered value circuit. The live alternative is a simpler claim that exemplary worshippers merely resist distraction.

changed_reading.before: Morning and evening mark a devotional schedule apart from ordinary work.
changed_reading.after: The raised house governs a whole economic day: trade continues, but attention is reclaimed, prayer is established, value is purified through giving, and provision is not reduced to exchange.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same praise root is followed by birds held in ordered lines, clouds gently driven, night and day turned, and creatures walking in different forms. Its movement branch becomes active: voiced praise in houses is the local human articulation of an ordered world already praising through flight, flow, alternation, and locomotion.

activation_trace.role: Coursing movement allows the focus praise to bridge vocal worship and ordered motion.
Morning departure embeds human praise in one phase of the world's recurring movement.
Evening supplies the complementary phase and ties local practice to cosmic alternation.
The repeated coursing branch extends the focus act from house occupants to the wider created order.
Light flight gives the cosmic praise a visible kinetic carrier.
Linear formation makes motion ordered rather than random.
Gentle driving of clouds adds atmospheric transport to the same ordered field.
Turning one face to another supplies the recurrent night-day transformation.
Multiple modes of walking extend embodied praise across created forms.

structural_cues: 24:41 repeats the focus praise root and explicitly coordinates prayer, praise, birds, and knowledge.
24:43-45 continue with cloud transport, night-day reversal, and differentiated creature movement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated praise plus a sequence of ordered motions; I infer that motion itself can bear the function of praise and that house worship consciously joins it. The alternative is that the later natural signs only exemplify divine power while praise remains exclusively verbal.

changed_reading.before: Humans recite praise inside houses at two times.
changed_reading.after: Household voices are the local audible register of a world-scale liturgy moving through birds, clouds, alternating time, and creaturely locomotion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later household rule divides the day into three permission-sensitive exposures around dawn prayer, midday undressing, and evening prayer. The focus's morning/evening praise now acts as part of a domestic clock that coordinates worship with protection of bodily vulnerability.

activation_trace.role: Authorization in the focus becomes the hinge between sacred timing and permitted access.
The early-day endpoint aligns focus praise with the opening privacy boundary.
The late-day endpoint aligns focus praise with the closing privacy boundary.
Required household permission makes timed access a protective practice.
The number three converts diffuse caution into a stable daily schedule.
Daybreak splitting from night establishes the first exposed threshold around prayer.
Clothing supplies the material boundary whose removal creates midday vulnerability.
Evening time establishes the final exposed threshold around prayer.
Mature household members' repeated permission makes the timed ethic persist beyond childhood.

structural_cues: 24:58 explicitly sequences dawn prayer, midday clothing removal, and evening prayer as three household vulnerabilities.
24:59 repeats the permission requirement after maturation, making the schedule developmental as well as temporal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies matching permission and daily-time roots in the focus and later domestic rules; I infer that recurring praise helps structure an ethical household day. The alternative is that focus time denotes only devotional frequency and the later schedule is legally independent.

changed_reading.before: Morning and evening simply indicate frequent praise.
changed_reading.after: Morning and evening are ethical hinges in a household clock where remembrance, prayer, permission, and bodily privacy regulate one another.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence distributes eating rights across a long kinship map of houses, includes impaired bodies, allows common or separate meals, and closes entry with peace. Plural houses in the focus can therefore be a networked social commons: elevated not by exclusion but by accessible nourishment, flexible gathering, and reciprocal greeting.

activation_trace.role: The house as its people lets the focus plural expand into a network of related households.
Literal loss of sight marks bodily difference as explicitly included in the house network.
Literal impaired gait adds mobility difference to the network's inclusion test.
Eating supplies the material act by which household access becomes nourishment rather than abstraction.
Repeated kin houses turn the singular sacred location model into a distributed social topology.
An instrument for reaching what is closed makes entrusted access materially operative.
Joining what is dispersed supports common meals and collective presence.
Dispersion preserves legitimate separate participation instead of making gathering coercive.
Peace-making at entry gives the network a reciprocal social tone.

structural_cues: 24:61 names a long sequence of kin houses, entrusted keys, a friend's house, eating together or apart, and greeting upon entry.
The absence of blame for blind, mobility-impaired, and ill participants precedes the house-and-meal network.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies plural household access, inclusion, food, flexible gathering, and greeting; I infer that these are concrete modes by which houses are socially elevated. The alternative is that 24:61 concerns food permissions only and should not qualify the worship houses of the focus.

changed_reading.before: Raised houses are exceptional devotional locations separated from ordinary domestic exchange.
changed_reading.after: The raised houses form an inclusive kin-and-friend network where sacred speech is embodied as access, nourishment, flexible company, and peace.

context_deltas.mechanism: Hearing becomes obedience, a gathering binds participants to remain until permission, and covert withdrawal is exposed as hiding behind others. The focus authorization can therefore govern not only entry into a building but presence within an assembly: elevation depends on responsive hearing and disclosed movement.

activation_trace.role: Attentive acceptance activates an auditory dimension inside the focus authorization.
Permission supplies the assembly's explicit rule for accountable movement.
Hearing that becomes understanding and compliance supplies the responsive posture.
Willing obedience completes the movement from received call to enacted response.
A call or occasion that gathers people turns the house model toward communal presence.
Repeated permission regulates departure and makes absence publicly accountable.
A person's concrete affair supplies the legitimate reason that permission can recognize.
Stealthy extraction models the unaccountable opposite of permitted departure.
Hiding behind another shows how communal presence can be evaded without disclosure.

structural_cues: 24:51 compresses faithful response into hearing followed by obedience.
24:62-63 contrast permission from a gathering with concealed withdrawal behind others.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an auditory response formula and a permission-governed assembly; I infer that the focus house can function as such an accountable gathering. The alternative is that these later rules concern prophetic authority without specifying the earlier houses.

changed_reading.before: Authorization concerns the status of the house itself.
changed_reading.after: Authorization also shapes the gathered people: a raised house is an accountable assembly whose members hear, respond, remain present, and disclose necessary departures.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the immediate syntax and lamp adjacency strongly favor dwellings. It remains anchored in the explicit focus branch for a metrical line and is activated by the packet's bounded-surah, signs, and parable branches. Downstream prose should present it only as lexical wordplay about textual architecture, never as a replacement for physical houses.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus dwelling root has a branch for a line of verse, while raising, vocal mention, and daily recitation can operate on a textual unit.

activation_trace.role: A metrical line supplies a bounded verbal house assembled from sounds and meanings.
Raised voice gives the textual house an audible mode of elevation.
Tongued mention performs the textual structure rather than leaving it inert.
A high or bounded portion activates the image of the surah as enclosed textual architecture.
Visible signs provide the constituent marked units of that architecture.
A formulated parable supplies a deliberately built verbal object within the surah.

changed_reading.before: Only physical or social houses are raised for praise.
changed_reading.after: At a secondary lexical level, bounded verbal houses are raised into audibility whenever the divine name is recurrently recited.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it layers household, tribal honor, and reputation branches onto a verse whose possessive grammar centers the divine name. It remains valid as a metonymic social reading because the packet explicitly supplies those focus branches and a long accusation-to-exoneration context. Downstream prose should qualify it as household reputational repair under divine remembrance, not as a claim that lineage itself is sacralized.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus house can denote a seat of lineage honor, raising can elevate rank, and mention and name can carry public renown.

activation_trace.role: A house as lineage honor makes family standing the vulnerable social object.
Elevation of rank models restoration after public degradation.
Honorable public mention supplies the reputational medium being repaired.

Verbal accusation supplies the reputational injury that can bring a household low.
Separation from the accusation supplies the explicit restorative movement.

changed_reading.before: The houses possess an already settled sacred honor.
changed_reading.after: The houses can also be damaged and restored social names: divine remembrance raises household standing by displacing accusation with exonerating, honorable speech.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant mapping from the focus name root to visible marking and shifts an auditory act toward visual wayfinding. It remains anchored by that supplied split inventory, physical raising, and the adjacent light branch for a visible beacon. Downstream prose should render it only as a cross-sensory material analogy, not as the lexical sense of the focus noun.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus noun for name has a supplied split branch for a visible identifying mark, and the houses are physically raised beside a dense light sequence.

activation_trace.role: A visible identifying mark lets the divine name function analogically as a sign borne by the house.
The dwelling supplies the material support on which the identifying sign becomes public.
Physical elevation gives the marked dwelling long-range visibility.
A conspicuous light-marker or beacon gives the raised sign a wayfinding function.

changed_reading.before: The divine name is only spoken inside the houses.
changed_reading.after: As a contained visual analogy, raised houses bear the divine name like illuminated identifying marks that orient people across the social landscape.

strongest_changes: The repeated house-entry and permission sequences recast divine authorization as a consent-sensitive ethics of thresholds.
The adjacent lamp assembly and later cosmic praise turn houses into luminous-acoustic nodes within a moving created order.
The scandal and market sequences make remembrance a counter-circulation: it disciplines both speech and value rather than remaining a secluded rite.
The later privacy clock and kin-house meal network make daily praise inseparable from bodily protection, inclusion, nourishment, and peace.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly reactivated the focus's own house, permission, mention, and praise roots at domestic, communal, economic, optical, and cosmic scales; the split inventory for the name root also preserved a contained visual-mark outlier.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the houses are primarily dedicated worship spaces or ordinary homes ethically elevated by these practices remains unresolved.
The scale-up from lamp niche to house and the counterflow from scandal to divine mention are reader-supplied causal links supported by adjacency and recurrence, not explicit causal syntax.
The kinetic, textual-house, and marked-beacon readings remain branch-distant and should stay exploratory rather than control synthesis.
